target.content: def run_cli(run, entry, name, arguments, cancel_after_connect=False):     """Run the packaged entrypoint with a minimal environment and an audit hook."""     hook = run.work / "hook"     hook.mkdir(exist_ok=True)     (hook / "sitecustomize.py").write_text(SITECUSTOMIZE, encoding="utf-8")     audit = run.work / f"{name}.audit.jsonl"     output = run.work / name     env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(run.work), "PYTHONPATH": str(hook),            "RELEASE_SMOKE_AUDIT_LOG": str(audit)}     started = time.monotonic()     out_log, err_log = run.work / f"{name}.stdout", run.work / f"{name}.stderr"     with open(out_log, "w") as stdout_file, open(err_log, "w") as stderr_file:         proc = subprocess.Popen([str(entry), *arguments, "--output-dir", str(output)], env=env,                                 stdout=stdout_file, stderr=stderr_file)         if cancel_after_connect:             deadline = time.monotonic() + 20             # waitid(WNOWAIT) observes exit without reaping, so wait4 below still owns the child.             while time.monotonic() < deadline and os.waitid(                 os.P_PID, proc.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT             ) is None:                 if audit.exists() and '"socket.connect"' in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):                     time.sleep(0.1)                     proc.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)                     break                 time.sleep(0.02)         # wait4 gives this process' own rusage (RUSAGE_CHILDREN would mix in the build).         _, wait_status, usage = os.wait4(proc.pid, 0)         proc.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(wait_status)     stdout, stderr = out_log.read_text(), err_log.read_text()     events = [json.loads(line) for line in audit.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if audit.exists() else []     run.measurements[name] = {         "wall_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),         "user_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_utime, 3),         "system_cpu_seconds": round(usage.ru_stime, 3),         "peak_rss_kib": next((e["kib"] for e in events if e["event"] == "peak_rss"), None),         "output_bytes": sum(p.stat().st_size for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) if output.exists() else 0,     }     return proc.returncode, stdout, stderr, output, events
